assigned_attacks.basis: All six deviation exponents use indices 1 through 6 of an arity-7 polynomial; index 0 is reserved and retained as the formal modulus coordinate.
The initial domain comes from exact hull inequalities and integral-point filtering. Later point-set convolution occurs only after that construction.
The source separately applies raw order weights, one domain dilation, and one 1/mu limit normalization.
The reducer admits only constant rational pivots and never inverts the formal modulus polynomial.
